summaryZh: Rifkin 实验室研究发育和生理过程如何减弱、放大并引导遗传、环境及随机变异，进而影响表型与进化。团队采用线虫胚胎发生和酵母信号及调控网络等模型系统，追踪变异来源到表型变异的机制。
researchQuestions: 发育和生理过程的结构与机制如何减弱或放大遗传、环境及随机变异，并引导其影响？
潜在的变异来源如何映射为表型变异？
methods: 酵母信号及调控网络模型

evidence.quote: We study how the structure and mechanics of developmental and physiological processes dampen or amplify genetic, environmental, and stochastic variation and channel their effects. We mechanistically trace how underlying sources of variation map to phenotypic variation. The lab works with several model systems including embryogenesis in nematodes and signaling and regulatory networks in yeast.
Rifkin Lab: On the Origin of Variation
